text:
Predicates:
GenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
UnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: the output of task x is a text sequence.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is a machine translation task.
Premises:
∀x (OutputIsTextSequence(x) → GenerationTask(x)) ::: If the output of a task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is a machine translation task.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: the output of machine translation is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
¬UnderstandingTask(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is not a language understanding task.
